item.title: Thirteen miles of I-94 to be rebuilt over next three years
item.description: This freeway is going to be totally rebuilt from Michigan Avenue all the way to I-275. The goal is to have two lanes open in each direction - so four lanes in total.

item.title: Kwame Kilpatrick restitution deal: Attorney explains how ex-mayor got amount lowered
item.description: Kilpatrick was convicted on 24 felony counts in 2013 including for bribery and racketeering in a pay-for-play scandal. His restitution was reduced from $1.7 million to about $800,000.

item.title: Previous home of Detroit family hit by drive-by shooting, their new house was then robbed
item.description: You often hear that bad things come in threes. Well, on Tuesday night, one Detroit family is really hoping their bad luck stops at two, after their home was shot up and their new home was ransacked.The Whitakers and their three kids were not hurt. Meanwhile, the shooters were never found, so the family had to move for safety.They later bought a house from the Land Bank and fixed it up until last week. They say it was burglarized.
